items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And he had the band when I worked for the Cavalcade of Broadway, Ed Sullivan's show, that the first broadway show that I played.

ctx.x: But I've always the person that would sit down and listen, I'm not going to give a man a hard time. Now, so Jolly Roll Sewell General gave me an opportunity to solo. Now, they came up into Sam Woodings band and when I went with -- to Europe with Sam, I was a lead trumpet player, but when Tommy left, I played all of Tommy's solos. In the band, and so that was the beginning of -- also it came gradual, cause I was in between playing lead trumpet, and solo, it came slowly, cause I worked with a fellow in New York…

And he had the band when I worked for the Cavalcade of Broadway, Ed Sullivan's show, that the first broadway show that I played. Bill Butler directed the band, there. And I also played some gigs with him.
